item.name: Shiny
item.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
item.effect: The highest listed income multiplier in the current 17-row source.
item.bestUse: Save high-BPS pets with this mutation because the multiplier is stronger than every other listed mutation.

item.name: Neon
item.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
item.bestUse: Keep on valuable income pets; it is the second-highest listed wild multiplier.

item.name: Glass
item.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
item.bestUse: Worth keeping on rare or high-BPS pets even when you are still chasing Shiny or Neon.

item.name: Rainbow
item.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
item.effect: Wild-spawn income multiplier equal to Bloodbound in the current source.
item.bestUse: Useful on any pet you plan to keep in the pen for steady income.

item.name: Gold
item.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
item.bestUse: A practical keeper mutation while farming for rarer 2.5x-plus results.

item.name: Albino
item.acquisition: Spawns randomly on the map as a wild animal variant.
item.bestUse: Good early value, but replaceable once Gold, Rainbow, Glass, Neon, or Shiny appears.

item.name: Bloodbound
item.acquisition: Collect Bloodmoon Grapes during Bloodmoon Weather and feed them to any pet.
item.bestUse: Use Bloodmoon Grapes on pets with strong base BPS instead of low-value filler pets.

item.name: Cosmic
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Cosmic Shower Weather.
item.bestUse: Trigger or join Cosmic Shower when your pen has pets worth upgrading.

item.name: Frozen
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Blizzard or Snowy Weather.
item.bestUse: Best watched during snow-related weather windows, especially if you are also farming weather spawns.

item.name: Fractured
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Gravebound Weather.
item.bestUse: Useful when Gravebound is active, especially alongside Skeletal Mutation Machine progress.

item.name: Charged
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Thunderstorm Weather.
item.bestUse: A smaller bonus, but Thunderstorm can also matter for Lightning Dragon spawning.

item.name: Admin
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during rare developer-triggered Admin Cloud Weather.
item.bestUse: Treat as opportunistic; do not plan a normal farming route around it.

item.name: Seabound
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Underwater or Tsunami Weather.
item.effect: Small income multiplier; Fandom also lists breed luck increase.
item.bestUse: More useful when the weather also supports ocean pet spawns or breeding plans.

item.name: Volcanic
item.acquisition: Applies randomly to pen pets during Volcanic Eruption Weather.
item.effect: Small income multiplier; Fandom also notes legendary lucky block behavior.
item.bestUse: Best treated as a weather bonus while farming lava-themed spawns or Volcanic Eruption rewards.

item.name: Lovestruck
item.acquisition: Collect Chocolate Hearts during Valentine's Weather and feed them to pets.
item.bestUse: Use on pets you expect to keep, because the event source is narrower than normal wild spawns.

item.name: Cupid
item.acquisition: Combine 5 of the same pet during Valentine's Weather to receive one Cupid version.
item.bestUse: Useful for event collection progress, but lower income value than Lovestruck.

item.name: Skeletal
item.acquisition: Place any pet into the Mutation Machine during Gravebound Weather.
item.bestUse: Use for Skeleton-event collection routes rather than raw income, since the multiplier is small.
